---
name: Something is missing
about: A setting, a Koenig card, or a part of the blog engine that did not come across
labels: enhancement
---

**What is missing.**

**Is it in the blog engine?** This theme has no design of its own — every visual decision was
made in [Quire Ink](https://github.com/joiha-steven/quireink) and measured there. If the thing
exists upstream, the question is which of its decisions failed to come across, and the answer
is usually a few lines in `tools/extract.ts`.

**Have you read `docs/gaps.md`?** Several absences are deliberate and each has the measurement
or the decision behind it: the pen, series, the archive block, right-to-left, a callout's
background colour, Ghost's font picker.
